newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KONSEL VOTED AUSTRIAN PLAYER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KONSEL VOTED AUSTRIAN PLAYER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Rapid Vienna goalkeeper Michael Konsel was on Tuesday voted Austria's Player of the Year by coaches of the country's 10 first division soccer clubs.
Konsel was judged Rapid's best player in all of the club's European Cup matches. The coaches also said he had excelled for the Austrian national side in their World Cup qualifying matches.
Konsel, 34, has helped put Rapid top of the Austrian league table, one point ahead of SV Salzburg. The league began its winter break after last weekend's matches.
"This is a great award which underlines my consistent performance throughout the year," said Konsel, who has been invited to play for an international team in a friendly in Brazil on December 17.
Second place in the vote, organised by the Austrian news agency APA since 1984, went to international forward Andreas Herzog who plays for Germany's Werder Bremen.
Konsel is only the second goalkeeper to receive the award following Austria Vienna's Franz Wohlfahrt in 1993.
